name: cross-margin-survival
description: Alice deposits USDC collateral, borrows ETH against it, and opens a perp position. The oracle then drops ETH from $100 to $90 — a 10% crash. In a siloed lending system (lending health checked alone) Alice would now be LIQUIDATABLE: her ETH debt is worth more in USDC terms and her collateral ratio crosses the maintenance threshold. Under princeps's unified portfolio margin (lending + perps in one pool), the unrealized PnL on her perp position absorbs the lending health hit; she ends the scenario HEALTHY. This is the core prime broker thesis: cross-asset risk netting that single-protocol systems cannot replicate.
headline: Cross-margin saves Alice from a 10% ETH crash: siloed-LIQUIDATABLE becomes unified-HEALTHY.

steps.explanation: Run the canonical lending-demo end-to-end. Walks the full deposit → borrow → open perp → ETH crash → re-evaluate-margin sequence in one ~1-second invocation. Output shows both siloed and unified margin numbers side by side.
